preconditions.description: The number of nodes n, edges m, and minimum degree k satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == m and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly m edges, each connecting two distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(v for u, v in edges if u == node) | set(u for u, v in edges if v == node)) >= k for node in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Every node in the graph has a degree of at least k.
The graph contains no multiple edges between the same pair of nodes.

postconditions.description: The length of the output cycle is at least k + 1.
All nodes in the output cycle are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for v in cycle_nodes)
postconditions.description: All nodes in the output cycle are valid node indices.

postconditions.expression: all((cycle_nodes[i], cycle_nodes[(i + 1) % len(cycle_nodes)]) in edge_set or (cycle_nodes[(i + 1) % len(cycle_nodes)], cycle_nodes[i]) in edge_set for i in range(len(cycle_nodes)))
postconditions.description: Every consecutive pair of nodes in the cycle (including the last and first) is connected by an edge in the graph.
